deeper_delvings.config.deepslateMineshaf: Adds deepslate mineshafts in deepslate levels, built from spruce wood and lit by lanterns, with more continuous rails, activator rails, TNT minecarts and more chest minecarts. These replace vanilla mineshafts in deepslate levels.
Adds crimson and warped mineshafts under the lava level of crimson and warped forests, with Fiery Spider spawners, Nether foliage, ancient debris at dead ends, ladder shafts up to lava lakes, piglin miners in crimson mineshafts and endermen in warped mineshafts.

Enables the Fiery Spider, a cave spider variant that sets its target on fire.
deeper_delvings.config.deepslateDungeonV:
Dungeons in deepslate levels are built from cobbled deepslate and mossy cobbled deepslate.

Enables the Mossy Deepslate block set.
deeper_delvings.config.bonusChests.desc: Places extra loot chests at random enclosed locations inside structures.
deeper_delvings.config.bonusChests.mansi: Chance for each valid spot inside a woodland mansion to get a chest.
deeper_delvings.config.bonusChests.monum: Chance for each valid spot inside an ocean monument to get a chest.
deeper_delvings.config.oreSizeMultiplier: Scales Overworld ore vein sizes by depth. The multiplier is 1 at the middle height and moves towards the minimum multiplier at the maximum height and towards the maximum multiplier at the minimum height.
Vein size multiplier at and above the maximum height.
Vein size multiplier at and below the minimum height.
Overrides the values above for veins that place the given ore block.
deeper_delvings.config.structureSpawnMul: Multiplies the number of dungeon placement attempts per chunk.
Overrides the dungeon chance multiplier for the given placed feature.
Multiplies the chance for mineshafts to generate in a chunk.
Overrides the mineshaft chance multiplier for the given structure set.
deeper_delvings.config.modIntegration.fi: Biomes in which spider spawns are replaced with Fiery Spiders. Adding any biome enables the Fiery Spider.
deeper_delvings.config.misc.caveAmbientS: Delay in ticks before cave ambient sounds can play. Lower values make them play more often. Vanilla is 6000.
